summary: Full E2E testing for Engwish Skills Academy. Backend enquiries API (POST/GET) verified with pytest (5/5 passed). Frontend Playwright verified hero, 3D slider, 4 course cards, course detail navigation, detail-enquire-btn round-trip, WhatsApp button href (wa.me/919000060601), navbar links, client-side validation toast, and successful enquiry submission with success toast + DB persistence.

issues: Swiper console warning: 'The number of slides is not enough for loop mode' (4 slides). Consider setting loop=false or duplicating slides to silence warning. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Fix Swiper loop warning by disabling loop when slides < required count or duplicating course slides.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stores created_at as ISO string in Mongo then re-parses on read — works, but consider storing native datetime for consistency.
No rate limiting on POST /api/enquiries — public form is spam-vulnerable; consider adding basic rate limit / captcha.
Enquiry model returns created_at as datetime; frontend does not consume it, fine.
CORS uses '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers ignore credentials with wildcard; acceptable for this public site but flagged.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed enquiries in MongoDB via API during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows working. Public URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Course slugs: spoken-english, study-abroad, ielts-duolingo, academic-coaching.
